report:
**Screen: methodology-390 (390px)**
- **Header auth buttons**: The preview renders exposed “vendors” and “sign in” text buttons in the collapsed header row; the design shows only the hamburger menu on mobile.
- **Hero top spacing**: The preview has visibly less top padding above the “Methodology” heading than the design.
- **Standards table truncation**: The rightmost “SOMETIMES” column is clipped in the preview; the design shows all five columns, implying the table should be horizontally scrollable or reflowed.
- **Labeling Score Works grid**: The preview renders the four explanatory items in a 2×2 grid; the design stacks them in a single column.
- **Labeling Score Calculated layout**: The preview places the two sub-sections (“If only a label claim is present” and “If both a label claim and batch claim are present”) side-by-side; the design stacks them vertically.
- **Section vertical rhythm**: Content sections in the preview sit closer together vertically than in the design.

**Screen: methodology-744 (744px)**
- **Header auth buttons**: The preview shows both a “vendors” outlined pill and a “sign in” green pill; the design shows only a single “sign up” green pill at this width.
- **Standards table density**: Table rows in the preview are taller due to more generous cell padding / text wrapping; the design uses more compact rows.
- **Formula cards**: The preview formula cards have larger internal padding, causing longer formulas (e.g., POSTERIOR MEAN, PRODUCT EVIDENCE SCALE) to wrap across three lines instead of the design’s two.
- **Footer columns**: Footer link columns in the preview are narrower and more tightly packed than in the design.

**Screen: methodology-1440 (1440px)**
- **Header CTA label**: The preview’s green header pill reads “sign in”; the design reads “sign up”.
- **Hero top padding**: The preview is missing roughly 24–40 px of top padding above the “Methodology” title.
- **Analysts/Vendors column ratio**: The preview uses a near 50/50 split for the two-column methodology section; the design uses an asymmetric split (roughly 40 % / 60 %) with a wider column gap.
- **Standards table column widths**: The preview distributes column widths roughly evenly; the design allocates more width to the “STANDARD” and “SOMETIMES” columns and less to the metric columns.
- **Labeling Score Works grid gap**: The vertical gap between the two rows of the 2×2 grid is larger in the preview than in the design.
- **Methodology note accent**: The “Methodology note” block in the preview lacks the left border accent visible in the design.
- **Formula card typography**: Formulas such as POSTERIOR MEAN and PRODUCT EVIDENCE SCALE break across extra lines in the preview because of slightly narrower card content boxes or larger font metrics.
- **Inter-section spacing**: The vertical spacing between the Reading Results, Leaderboard, and Footer sections is slightly tighter in the preview than in the design.
- **Footer layout**: Footer columns in the preview are more narrowly packed; the design spreads them across a wider area with larger inter-column gutters.
